assertions.name: internally selects core recipes and never omits captured roots when the caller supplies a subset
distinguishes proved empty catalogs from missing APIs and produces C4 construction obligations
produces equal Chrome/Desktop token semantics while retaining distinct source observation hashes
retains timing, easing, aliases, multiple actual mode IDs and unsupported future material
does not guess cross-collection aliases by mode name or silently resolve material conflicts
exports styles-only color tokens and retains gradient/image/effect/grid material instead of empty success
audits raw paints and text runs by actual material, preserving opacity and duplicate-style ambiguity
verifies actual asset bytes and keeps distinct root usages even when PNG hashes match
turns source reactions into required assertions and blocks missing destinations and unknown actions
pages more than 4096 actual mode rows without dropping records and rejects tampered pages
rejects mutated normalized evidence and forged source capsules
uses canonical mappings from actual bounded source bytes, retaining source-qualified collisions and overrides
gives same-source same-name component mappings distinct stable review obligations
retains deterministic source-bound page and manifest hashes without claiming runtime use
keeps historical manifests readable but rejects the prior derivation identity for adoption
recounts page obligations/issues and checks material hashes before result-store adoption
preserves actual verified and stale mapping override status from the canonical adapter
rejects source bytes changed between complete inventory and actual canonical analysis
pages canonical component membership without dropping repeated instances or accepting missing members
requires missing operational layers for a frontend-only reference while keeping C4 frontend-only
bounds sparse variable-mode expansion without discarding the retained observed values
does not export a bound paint style as one unconditional default-mode color
keeps image-fill and vector usage separate from root exports and verifies their exact bytes
retains non-array mixed style material as unresolved instead of a proved empty audit
retains every source candidate for an exact review of the produced pattern-route diagnostic
keeps pattern-route reviews exact and preserves unused-review and hard-failure guards
preserves qualified frontend closure, full byte inventory and scoped canonical mapping candidates
whole-root default remains explicit and retains all services rather than pretending a narrower selection
retains related runtime and configuration dependencies while excluding an unrelated sibling
derives selected React extensions and tokens instead of the excluded Angular root profile
rebases a selected token config and retains its full-root relative import dependency
honors exact admitted Node HTTP semantic reviews while retaining raw diagnostics and review bindings
rejects stale, wrong-offset and wrong-source semantic reviews instead of accepting a caller completion claim
qualifies same-path references in one global batch and rejects omitted or reordered members
hard syntax errors cannot be waived by a review or replaced by a complete flag
full-root byte failures and canonical mapping discovery limits stay hard failures
unsupported imported-theme values remain unmapped obligations without a guessed token
unsupported Vue runtime stays unresolved or reviewed with conservative closure instead of silently narrowing it
truncated semantic diagnostics stay blocked even when every retained diagnostic has an exact review
a semantic review cannot cross a global source index in same-path references
typed source context pages reject altered selection identity even with recalculated page envelopes
retains a related backend dependency instead of constructing an already selected backend layer
missing source context cannot be hidden by recalculating page counts and hashes
selected source and pattern size limits remain blocked with their original diagnostics
bounds source review inputs before reading getters or recursive context material
maps a one-character selected root without absorbing its nested or sibling services

limits: Original raw report remains local-only; stacks/source snippets/actor-state omitted. Summary cannot issue authority or convert a failed full report to pass.
